The comparison does not alter the model, observations, initial conditions, or training ranking.

result.meaning: Finite conditional damping calibration from an explicit original prefix, fixed restoring coefficients and original start. Later values do not fit damping. Grid/local refinement is not a global optimizer or uncertainty interval; consumed data remains exploratory.

metrics.meaning: Original seed metrics do not apply

limitations: Fixed-step RK4 has no automatic local-error or stiffness estimate.
Coulomb sign changes and other nonsmooth behavior can require smaller steps.
A finite rollout is not evidence of physical validity, parameter identifiability, or calibrated uncertainty.
Residuals include angular-model, sensor, initial-state, unrecorded-forcing and numerical errors.
Physical torque and inertia remain unidentified.
